currentState: Easy road courtesy. Lyriel answers the carter as she would anyone on the road: warm, true, a little teasing, 'friend'. Cyndia (within earshot, bow still up) hears the whole exchange; Sylvanas, Jaina and the girl are also present. The carter laughs once and thanks no one; he takes in the line of horses and drives on.
powerDynamic: Neither controls the exchange: he asks, she answers; the party holds the bows, he holds the information about the south.

physicalDynamics.pattern: Lyriel lowers her bow and tips her head back toward the yard gate where the girl leans on Neral's saddle; the carter's eyes go past the party toward Millhaven, then once along the line of horses front to back.

history.event: He asks whether they passed a young fellow with a grain cart, a new man; Lyriel says they passed nobody, the little one mentioned a newer grain seller, they will watch for him going south and tell him he is wanted, and that he'll get a better price going home full.

trajectory: Plan-sourced (not on page): this is the plant for the Ch5 depot / Ch9 ward and the Ch15 corroboration. The prose must not explain it.
